name: How do I keep an outdoor entertainment area from feeling too hot?

mainEntity.name: What is the best way to keep an outdoor entertainment area cool during summer afternoons in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the best way to keep an outdoor entertainment area cool during summer afternoons in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heat control starts with reducing direct sun exposure. Shade structures, patio covers, pergolas with canopy systems, and strategically placed trees are the most effective tools. After that, add airflow with outdoor fans or cross-breeze planning so hot air does not settle in the seating area. Light-colored paving and finishes help reduce heat absorption, while dark stone or dense surfaces can stay uncomfortably warm. Seating should be placed where it benefits from shade for the longest part of the day, not just at noon. If the space includes a grill or fire feature, keep those elements far enough from seating so they do not add unnecessary heat. In warmer Los Angeles neighborhoods, the most comfortable outdoor rooms are usually designed around shade first and décor second.
